studies.title: Rousta TV
studies.problem: A Persian-language media and community platform for Iranian villages — rural news, village micro-sites, a marketplace, eco-tourism content, live streaming, chat rooms, and member profiles with a wallet.
studies.contribution: Sole fullstack developer over roughly three months. Built the entire application end to end — data model, server, APIs, and pages. Development only: did not own product design, content, or product management.
studies.outcome: Live in production and publicly used.
